chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
about the one who has never performed hajj: may he perform hajj using zakat?

key_terms.الصَّرُورَةِ: a person who has never performed hajj
key_terms.نَعَمْ: an affirmative legal response meaning yes

ai.seo_question: Can someone who has never performed hajj use zakat funds to go for hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about whether a person who has not yet performed hajj may do so using zakat funds. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام replies in the affirmative, indicating permissibility in this case.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1632 - Muhammad ibn Muslim asked Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)
about a person who has never performed Hajj (ṣarūrah): "Can they perform Hajj using Zakat funds?"
